scenes.name: intro
scenes.text: Mark lives on a farm. He has a big purple tractor with a trailer. Every day, he drives it to the park.

scenes.name: problem
scenes.text: One day, a car stops at the side of the road. A girl gets out. "Help! My sister is sick!"

scenes.name: solution
scenes.text: The car will not go. So the girls sit in Mark's trailer, and he takes them to the doctor.

scenes.name: ending
scenes.text: Mark parks his tractor outside. The doctor and the nurse help her sister. "Thank you, Mark!" says the girl. "You are a star!"

scenes.name: intro
scenes.text: Roy is a boy with a toy cow. He keeps his coins in it. Today, he takes one coin out.

scenes.name: problem
scenes.text: Roy runs out of the house to play. Oh, no! The coin falls and rolls under a bush.

scenes.name: solution
scenes.text: Roy looks and looks. Then a little brown mouse runs out of the bush. The mouse pulls the coin out of the soil!

scenes.name: ending
scenes.text: "Thank you, Mouse!" says Roy. He gives the mouse some bread. Then he puts the coin back in his toy cow.

scenes.name: intro
scenes.text: It is August, and it is Paul's birthday. His gift is a big board and some chalk!

scenes.name: problem
scenes.text: First, Paul draws a tall horse. Then he draws a big lion. "Roar!" says Paul.

scenes.name: solution
scenes.text: His little sister Dawn walks in. She sees the lion on the board and runs away!

scenes.name: ending
scenes.text: So Paul draws a smile on the lion and a ball for it. Now Dawn is not scared. She draws too!

scenes.name: intro
scenes.text: The sky is clear. Mary and her dad have a picnic on a square blanket. They have bread and a big pear.

scenes.name: problem
scenes.text: A little deer walks near. Its ears go up. The deer looks at the pear.

scenes.name: solution
scenes.text: Mary breaks the pear in two. "I can share," she says. She gives one half to the deer.

scenes.name: ending
scenes.text: The deer eats the pear. Then the deer puts its head on Mary's lap. Dad gives a big cheer!

scenes.name: intro
scenes.text: Tina, her mom, and her baby brother Leo stay at a big hotel. It is cold outside.

scenes.name: problem
scenes.text: They go up in the elevator. Leo does not like it. He cries and cries.

scenes.name: solution
scenes.text: A lady in a red uniform plays soft music. Then she gives Leo a toy tiger.

scenes.name: ending
scenes.text: Leo stops crying. He hugs his tiger. "Thank you!" says Tina. "Now he loves the elevator!"

scenes.name: intro
scenes.text: It is raining at the zoo. Ana has a big yellow umbrella. She wants to see the panda.

scenes.name: problem
scenes.text: The monkey eats a banana under a tree. The gorilla and his son eat bananas there too. They are all dry.

scenes.name: solution
scenes.text: But the panda sits all alone in the rain. The panda is wet and sad.

scenes.name: ending
scenes.text: Ana gives her umbrella to the zookeeper. He opens it over the panda. What a surprise! The panda loves it!

scenes.name: intro
scenes.text: Kim lives on a farm near an old castle. She has a little white lamb.

scenes.name: problem
scenes.text: One day, the lamb runs away. Kim puts on her gloves and blows her whistle. But the lamb does not come back.

scenes.name: solution
scenes.text: First, Kim runs the wrong way. Then she falls and hurts her knee.

scenes.name: ending
scenes.text: At last, Kim finds her lamb in the castle garden. The lamb is eating rhubarb!

scenes.name: intro
scenes.text: Sam's class goes on an excursion to the forest. They meet at the train station.

scenes.name: problem
scenes.text: Sam loves nature. He takes a picture of a beautiful bird in a tree.

scenes.name: solution
scenes.text: His teacher is very helpful. She puts his picture in a big competition.

scenes.name: ending
scenes.text: Sam wins! His picture is on television. Now Sam and the bird are famous!
